The implementation correctly makes all tests pass, but the PR description is inaccurate. It claims the change is "per the docstring and tests," but the docstring examples (showing "up to and including 2.0 kg -> 790") actually contradict this change. The implementation deviates from the docstring to match the test expectations.

Please update the PR description to either:
1. Acknowledge that the implementation contradicts the docstring examples (and explain why tests take precedence), or
2. Propose updating the docstring examples to match the new weight tier boundaries

The actual code logic is sound and functionally correct for the test suite, but the documentation of the change should accurately reflect that it contradicts the docstring as originally written.
